scope: Only benchmark harness, results, and benchmark documentation; no retrieval behavior changes.
methods: rg --no-config -l -i -F --sort path with OR query terms
query_policy: Exact original doc field; rg alone uses fixed sgrep-style query tokenization; no expansions or per-query tuning.
corpus_policy: Original code including docstrings, unchanged UTF-8, one .py file per snippet with opaque SHA256 filename; labels, queries and logs outside corpus; no clone of original repos. Precreate an empty .ckignore so CK does not generate searchable comment text; verify CK semantic indexes all 6267 snippets and CK lexical has 6267 snippets plus its empty configuration document. Independently inspect lexical stored paths to confirm no missing snippets. The empty config has no searchable content.
ranking: First 10 unique valid corpus paths in native result order; repeated chunks do not earn extra rank slots; one official relevant code per query.
failure_contract: Gold text differs from actual snippet
Queries or labels leak into searchable files
Duplicate chunks count as distinct code results
Invalid paths or malformed output silently score as success
Indexing time counted as query time
Cached timing presented as cold start
MRR@10 presented as full-corpus official MRR
evidence: Dataset and binary SHA256, corpus manifest, exact argv, stdout/stderr and timings for every search, replay scoring verification, aggregate and per-query results.
timing: Sequential fresh CLI invocations, rotating tool order per query; initial model warmup on dev split excluded and retained; initial CK index measured separately; filesystem caches not flushed; local host load uncontrolled.
limitations: Python snippet retrieval, not whole-repository navigation
Single official positive may undercredit valid alternatives
Literal OR ripgrep is not an agent writing grep patterns
selection: All 500 held-out test queries; dev first query for parser/warmup only
protocol_revision: The interrupted pilot exposed CK lexical indexing its generated .ckignore. CK --exclude did not remove it. Precreate an empty config, verify native index document counts, retain interrupted runs, rebuild the lexical index and rerun all methods on all queries. No retrieval model or query tuning.
